title: We've Made It to the Top
description: Narrating past events: choosing between the present simple for a general truth, the simple past for a finished past action, and the present perfect for a past action whose time is not stated; the affirmative, negative and interrogative forms of both past tenses (didn't + base verb, have/has + past participle); the fourteen irregular verbs of the lesson (be, begin, buy, come, dream, find, get, go, have, know, leave, lose, make, sell) in the simple past and the past participle; and the time markers (ago, last year, in 1998 / ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for) that decide which past tense a sentence needs
sources: Official programme — English, 1st year of secondary education (tronc commun), CNP Tunisia; transcription content/programmes-officiels/programme/1ere-sec/anglais.md, § Lesson 2
